== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 3]] ("Return Of The Jedi"), from the cover page of the Virtual Block 3: Return Of The Jedi PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of December 7, 2009". The file was created on 18 December 2009.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf VirtualBlock3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 158 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1028&times;633 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive].
